mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST rise, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates continued economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential sales (RSAFS) below 340,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is below 340000, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a labor market tightening that is being met with monetary policy tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates slower growth.
regime_hint: labor market tightening with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 115), the economy is in a contraction phase, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 115, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
